installCommand: if [ -n "$npm_config_cache_dir" ]; then export npm_config_cache="$npm_config_cache_dir"; unset npm_config_cache_dir; fi; if [ -n "$NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR" ]; then export NPM_CONFIG_CACHE="$NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR"; unset NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR; fi; npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
buildCommand: if [ -n "$npm_config_cache_dir" ]; then export npm_config_cache="$npm_config_cache_dir"; unset npm_config_cache_dir; fi; if [ -n "$NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR" ]; then export NPM_CONFIG_CACHE="$NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR"; unset NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR; fi; npm --prefix frontend run build
